What lies behind the werewolf legend, and how does a household become the centre of a poltergeist mystery?

LISTEN TO THE FULL INTERVIEW HERE > https://open.spotify.com/episode/15uobIm2pOFC7Ogo2XpGzV

The Paranormal Chronicles Podcast invites listeners into a world of unsettling folklore and unexplained disturbances in its episode, “Real Life Werewolves and the Haunted Bells Mystery!”

Bestselling paranormal author and host G. L. Davies welcomes author, researcher and publisher Anna Dowling (Pengergast Books) for a conversation exploring werewolf traditions and the curious case of the Bealings Bells in Suffolk.

For anyone whose knowledge of werewolves begins with horror films, this episode offers a chance to explore the stories behind the familiar monster. Davies and Dowling turn to the folklore that keeps the werewolf such a compelling and disturbing figure.

Why does the idea of human transformation still grip our imagination?

The conversation also explores the Bealings Bells, a Suffolk mystery associated with alleged poltergeist activity. Even the ordinary sound of a ringing bell takes on a different character when it becomes part of an unexplained disturbance. Listeners are invited to discover a case whose intriguing title alone raises questions.

Blending werewolf folklore with a historical haunting mystery, this 34-minute episode offers an accessible introduction for newcomers and an absorbing listen for established followers of paranormal history. Dowling’s interest in forgotten literature and the uncanny makes her a fitting companion on this journey into strange territory.
